name: valid_flow_declaration
description: Flow with multiple stages and dependencies parses successfully
input:
use
  llm.reason
  web.search

flow research
  needs topic: Text
  gives Text

  stage gather_web
    result = search topic

  stage gather_papers
    result = search "{topic} academic paper"

  stage synthesize
    needs gather_web.result, gather_papers.result
    draft = reason "synthesize: {gather_web.result} {gather_papers.result}"

  stage verify
    needs synthesize.draft
    give reason "check: {synthesize.draft}"
